firstLines: Andre Whitaker
Austin, TX | (512) 555-0154 | andre.whitaker@example.com | linkedin.com/in/andrewhitaker
SUMMARY
Customer success manager with seven years in software for labs and event teams. I manage renewals worth
about $4 million a year, and I'm known for catching unhappy accounts early, before they show up in the numbers.
EXPERIENCE
Senior Customer Success Manager Apr 2022 – Present
Quill & Flask Labs Austin, TX
• Manage 45 lab accounts with $4.1 million in yearly renewals and 96% gross retention last year
• Built a health score from support tickets and product usage that flags accounts at risk about two months
earlier than before
• Lead quarterly business reviews with lab directors and bring their requests back to the product team
• Onboarded and coached three new managers on the team
Customer Success Manager Jan 2019 – Mar 2022
Tallowbird Events Austin, TX
• Looked after 120 event agencies through the switch to a new ticketing platform, losing only four
• Wrote the onboarding guide and video series that cut setup calls from three to one
• Turned 22 accounts into paid upgrades by showing them features they already had but didn't use
• Ran the customer advisory group of 12 agencies that tested new features before release
Account Coordinator Jun 2017 – Dec 2018
Rattlebrush Brewing Company San Antonio, TX
• Handled orders and delivery problems for 90 bars and restaurants across three cities
• Kept the distributor price list current and caught billing errors before invoices went out
• Set up delivery schedules with three distributors and handled out-of-stock calls
EDUCATION
Mesquite Hollow University San Marcos, TX
Bachelor of Business Administration May 2017
SKILLS
Customer tools: Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, Zendesk
Data: Excel, Looker, basic SQL
